title: Mac: Electrobun launchers (3d-viewer, face-swap, img-gen); install_mac --with-bun-install
paragraphs:
- POSIX scripts mirror VBS env (GLB_FILE, TARGET_IMAGE, FOLDER_PATH, .env) and build-on-first-run.
- install_mac.sh links the three commands; --with-bun-install|-B runs bun install in every tools/*/ package.json tree.
- AGENTS file tree notes install_mac.sh and Electrobun folders.

title: Add local face swap desktop tool and finish the integration.
paragraphs: This adds a drag-and-drop InsightFace face swap app with Explorer integration, docs, site metadata, and generated artwork so it feels like a finished tool. It also fixes the Electrobun first-paint sizing bug in the image windows so they open at the correct size.

title: Replace AbortController with Promise.race timeout, add log file
paragraphs: AbortController + signal was potentially hanging Bun's fetch in the bundle. Promise.race with a timeout promise is simpler and guaranteed to work. Added log file at %TEMP%\img-gen\img-gen.log to debug silent failures.

title: Fix stuck generating state - add 90s request timeout and surface all errors via SSE
paragraphs: generateOne now aborts after 90s so hanging API calls don't freeze the UI. runGeneration wraps the whole loop in an outer try/catch so unexpected crashes broadcast an imageError SSE instead of being swallowed by .catch(console.error). Added es.onerror handler so SSE reconnects are logged to console.

title: Fix RPC timeout - make generate non-blocking, add generation tests
paragraphs: generate() now returns {jobId} immediately and streams results via SSE. Extracted pure generation logic into generation.ts with 22 unit tests. UI handleSend now fires .catch() instead of await to match the non-blocking contract.

title: Faster launch - skip rebuild if built, add HTML loading splash
Add visible settings strip with aspect ratio, size and variations controls
Fetch live image model list from OpenRouter API on startup
Fix API key loading - read .env in VBS launcher instead of built app
Fix img-gen HTML script tag to use views:// URL like 3d-viewer
Add img-gen tool - chat-style AI image generation GUI
paragraphs: Electrobun app (same stack as 3d-viewer) that opens from right-clicking any folder in Explorer via Mike's Tools. Features:

- Chat-style interface with iterative refinement - each generation uses the last produced image as visual context automatically
- Annotation modal with freehand pen, rectangle, circle, arrow, and text label tools (all in red) - annotated output feeds into the next prompt
- File attach via picker + drag-and-drop images into the chat
- Generated images are draggable out to Explorer (file:// URL via DataTransfer)
- Download button copies image to the right-clicked folder
- Model selector (Gemini 3.1 Flash / 2.5 Flash / 3 Pro), aspect ratio and image size controls
- Same OpenRouter + Gemini image generation logic as generate-from-image
- Real-time progress via SSE from the local Bun HTTP server
- Registered in install.ps1 on Directory and Directory\Background Mike's Tools
